entries.name: Sacred Arrow
entries.transcript: Sacred Arrow. Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun starts at 0.01 seconds. Its maximum duration is 2.3, 3.2, 4.1, or 5 seconds, at ability levels 1 through 4, respectively. Up to 180 bonus damage is added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. It instantly kills the first non-ancient creep that it hits.
